report.verdict: A senior backend engineer with substantial payments work and results a recruiter can understand.
write_up: Your resume tells a strong senior backend story! At Lumen Ledger, you built payments infrastructure, led a ledger migration and improved API performance, with the scale or result attached to each.

The balance API line is especially good: it shows the latency before and after and names the change you made. Your earlier freight work carries the same specificity, though the claims services line leaves more to the imagination.

Start by adding one concrete piece of work from Northgate, then consider leading with the latency result. Your resume gives a recruiter a strong reason to keep reading; competition for senior backend roles will still matter.

cards.line: Maintained the claims intake services in Java
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter knows which services you worked on, but not what maintaining them involved. One change or problem you handled would make the work more concrete.
cards.example: Maintained the claims intake services in Java by [work performed]
cards.question: What did you work on in the claims intake services?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 1
cards.line: Designed and built the idempotent payouts service in Go and PostgreSQL that now settles about 1.8M payouts a month
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It names your part, the service, the tools and how much the service handles.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For roles above senior engineer, a platform-wide decision would show how you shaped the larger system, if you made one.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends, including [a platform-wide decision you made]
cards.question: What platform-wide decision, if any, did you make during the migration?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Consider putting this first in the Lumen Ledger role. The before and after makes the performance improvement immediately visible.

fit.why: Your headline and your payments platform work point directly to senior backend engineering.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your payments and freight work points toward backend roles involving distributed services and data systems. For a role above senior, bring forward any broader technical decisions you made if you can describe them.
